# Defect Triage

Review new/known defects. Classify severity and priority based on security, data loss, publishing side effects, user impact, frequency and release risk. Confirm reproducibility and affected requirement IDs. Do not close without a fix build, retest evidence and regression test. Distinguish defect from requirement change or environment problem. Update defect log and traceability after authorization.
